camel_example: aliyun push UnbindTag --region cn-hangzhou --KeyType DEVICE --TagName 'test_tag1,test_tag2' --AppKey 23267207 --ClientKey e2ba19de97604f55b165576730000
description_en: Unbinds one or more tags from a specified target
description_zh: 解绑指定的TAG和其目标之间的关系
kebab_example: aliyun push unbind-tag --app-key 23267207 --client-key e2ba19de97604f55b165576730000 --key-type DEVICE --tag-name test_tag1,test_tag2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindTag

parameters.help_en:
The type of the ClientKey. Valid value:

DEVICE: The key is a device ID
parameters.help_zh:
ClientKey的类型。可取值：

DEVICE：设备
parameters.name: key_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies the tag to unbind. To unbind multiple tags, separate them with commas. A maximum of 10 tags, each up to 128 characters long, can be unbound per request. The system supports a total of 10,000 tags
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的Tag，多个Tag用逗号分隔，系统总共支持1万个Tag，此接口一次最多能解绑10个Tag。长度限制：不大于128字符
parameters.name: tag_name
